title: Promoting the Responsible Development of Speech Datasets for Mental Health and Neurological Disorders Research
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark and does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is a survey paper that proposes a checklist for the responsible development of speech datasets for mental health research.
findings: This paper does not analyze religion; its focus is on creating responsible speech datasets for mental health and neurological disorders research. There are no findings related to religion.
